content.short: Lifetime Web3 domains on many chains, paid once with no renewal fees.
content.description: InfinityName sells blockchain names that never expire. Each network has its own ending, such as .unicorn on Unichain, .hood on Robinhood Chain, .blue on Base and .mon on Monad, and a name works as a wallet alias that can be traded like an NFT. There is one on-chain payment and nothing to renew, plus a marketplace, referrals and a leaderboard.
content.meta: Register a permanent Web3 name like .unicorn on Unichain or .hood on Robinhood Chain with InfinityName, no renewals.
